title: Lite Gym — Drills & Workouts Catalog
description: 45 browser-graded exercises combining 20 Litelings concept drills and 25 belt-ranked problem workouts across White, Amber, Emerald, and Obsidian tiers.

exercises.title: Immutable := vs Mutable var
hints: By default `:=` introduces a read-only binding that cannot appear on the left side of `=` or `+=`.
Change `count := n;` to `var count := n;`.

exercises.title: Reserved = ? Init Before Read
hints: `var label: String = ?;` is uninitialized until every possible control-flow branch assigns to it.
Add `else { label = "negative"; }` right after the `if n >= 0 { ... }` block.

exercises.title: Floor :/ :% vs Truncating / %
hints: `/` and `%` truncate toward zero (`-7 / 2 == -3`, `-7 % 2 == -1`).
Replace `/` with `:/` and `%` with `:%`.

exercises.title: Value-Returning if / else
hints: In Lite, a partial `if cond { "pass" }` without `else` evaluates to `""` when `score < 60`.
Append `else { "retry" }` after `{ "pass" }`.

exercises.title: Mandatory _ Arm in Match
hints: Subjectless `match { ... }` must terminate with a `_ { ... }` fallback arm.
Add `_ { "C" }` before the closing `}` of `match`.

exercises.title: Subject Match & Range Guard
hints: Comparison patterns cannot be chained (`>= 10 < 20` is rejected).
Bind the value and use an `if` guard: `v if 10 <= v < 20 { "teens" }`.

exercises.title: Loop break Payload & then Clause
hints: Tag the loop `@scan loop [a, b, c] as v` and use `break v;` to deliver the found element into `@scan.value`.
Inside `then`, leading-dot `.value` is unavailable inside conditionals—write `if @scan.value >= 0 { @scan.value + @scan.count } else { -1 }`.

exercises.title: Shorthand Labels & Tuple Destructuring
hints: Tuple destructuring `(a, b) := tuple;` binds fields positionally in order.
Change `(r, c) := relabelled;` to `(c, r) := relabelled;`.

exercises.title: Explicit mut List Storage
hints: In-place mutation (`mut items`) is rejected unless `items` was declared with `mut List<Int>`.
Change `items: List<Int> = [a];` to `items: mut List<Int> = [a];`.

exercises.title: Inner Type Alias Shadowing
hints: Outer `NumOrText` is `String`, so `Pair` inside the block sees `String` fields unless shadowed.
Add `NumOrText := type Int;` inside `total := { ... }` (before or after `Pair`, since inner aliases wire forward!).

exercises.title: Record =name Shorthand & Destructuring
hints: Record destructuring does not allow bare `{ base, bonus }` without `=`.
Change `{ base, bonus } := entry;` to `{ = base, = bonus } := entry;`.

exercises.title: Named Tuple & Fixed-Array Destructuring
hints: `pair` stores `right` before `left`, so positional `(l, right)` swaps the values.
Destructure by field name and shorthand: `(l = left, = right) := pair;`.

exercises.title: Block Final-Item Value Rule
hints: Ending `{ ... product := scaled * h; }` with a declaration makes the block yield `Unit` instead of `Int`.
Replace `product := scaled * h;` with the value expression `scaled * h`.

exercises.title: Parallel Wiring & Mutual Recursion
hints: `isEven(0)` should return `true` and `isOdd(0)` should return `false`.
Also guard negative inputs with `if k < 0 { self(0 - k) }` so recursion terminates cleanly.

exercises.title: Trace Safety on Reserved Storage
hints: Executing `readBonus()` before `bonus = n * 2;` reads an uninitialized `= ?` variable.
Swap `res := readBonus();` and `bonus = n * 2;` so initialization happens first.

exercises.title: Named Arguments & self Recursion
hints: In `self(n = n - 1, acc = acc)`, the accumulator never changes.
Change `acc = acc` to `acc = acc + n`.

exercises.title: Callable Types & Inference
hints: `steps` requires functions of type `IntOp` (`fn(Int): Int`), not `String`.
Replace `fn(x) { "triple" }` with `fn(x) { x * 3 }`.

exercises.title: Independent Closure State Frames
hints: Calling `makeCounter(s2, 5)` overwrites `sharedCurrent`, breaking `c1`.
Remove the outer `sharedCurrent` variable and declare `var current := start;` inside `makeCounter`.

exercises.title: core/text Trim & Code-Point Indexing
hints: Leading/trailing spaces or tabs count toward `text.length(line)` unless trimmed first.
Call `cleaned := text.trim(raw);` before reading `text.length(cleaned)` and `text.at(cleaned, ...)`.

exercises.title: core/format Table Padding
hints: Left-aligning text pads spaces on the right (`padRightText`); right-aligning numbers pads spaces on the left (`padLeftText`).
Swap `padLeftText` and `padRightText` in `row`.

exercises.title: core/unicode Scalars vs UTF-8 Bytes
hints: Non-ASCII code points take 2–4 UTF-8 bytes even though they have scalar length 1.
Import `core/unicode` and compute `unicode.utf8Encode(s).length()`.

exercises.title: Mutable Map<K, V> Grants
hints: Change `scores: Map<String, Int>;` to `scores: mut Map<String, Int>;` so the map allows writes.
Pass an explicit `mut` grant to `map.set(mut scores, "bonus", bonus);`.

exercises.title: Exhaustive Enum match
hints: Every declared case of `State` (`Ready`, `Busy`, `Stopped`) must be covered in `match s { ... }`.
Add `.Stopped { "stopped" }` inside the `match s` expression.

exercises.title: Mutable Set<T> Grants
hints: Change `seen: Set<Int>;` to `seen: mut Set<Int>;` so the set allows mutations.
Pass an explicit `mut` grant to `set.add(mut seen, 10);` and `set.add(mut seen, x);`.

exercises.title: Temperature Scale Converter
hints: Read `mode` first as a trimmed line, then `temp` as an integer.
In `C2F`, add `32` (do not subtract `32`).

exercises.title: Duration Breakdown (H/M/S)
hints: Take `remAfterHours := total % 3600;` before dividing by `60` for minutes.
Reject `total < 0` with `"INVALID"`.

exercises.title: Split Bill in Minor Units
hints: Check `cents < 0 or people <= 0` BEFORE dividing.
Use integer `/` and `%` to print `each:<q> rem:<r>`.

exercises.title: Gregorian Leap Year Rules
hints: Century years divisible by `100` are NOT leap years unless also divisible by `400`.
Combine `(year % 400 == 0) or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 =!= 0)`.

exercises.title: Clamp to Range & Sign Label
hints: Check both `x < lo` and `x > hi` inside `match { ... }`.
Classify the clamped value (not original `x`) as `neg`, `zero`, or `pos`.

exercises.title: Safe Quotient Guard
hints: Dividing by `0` panics at runtime unless guarded first.
Branch on `if b == 0 { io.outputLine("ERR:div-zero"); } else { ... }`.

exercises.title: Collatz Steps & Peak Value
hints: Initialize `var peak := n;` and update `if cur > peak { peak = cur; }` on every step.
Loop while `cur > 1` (for `n == 1`, `steps` is `0` and `peak` is `1`).

exercises.title: Euclid GCD & Zero-Safe LCM
hints: Take magnitudes first with `absVal` before running `loop b =!= 0`.
When either input is `0`, `lcm` is `0` cleanly without dividing by zero.

exercises.title: Numeric Palindrome & Digit Sum
hints: Build `rev = rev * 10 + (cur % 10);` while summing digits.
`isPal := n >= 0 and rev == mag;` ensures negative numbers are `false` while `0` is `true`.

exercises.title: Prime Range Count & Sum
hints: Handle `n == 2` explicitly (it is the only even prime), and check odd divisors up to `d * d <= n`.
Start iteration at `2` when `lo < 2`.

exercises.title: Caesar Cipher Rotation
hints: Convert text to scalar code points via `unicode.toCodePoints(line)`.
Because `:% 26` always produces `0..25`, negative shifts like `-3` wrap cleanly: `65 + ((cp - 65 + (shift :% 26)) :% 26)`.

exercises.title: Run-Length Encoder
hints: Handle empty strings early (`n == 0`).
Track `var cur := text.at(line, 0)` and `var run := 1;`, flushing `cur + integer.intText(run)` whenever the character changes and once after the loop.

exercises.title: Balanced Brackets Validator
hints: Counting depth alone fails on crossed pairs like `"([)]"`.
Push opening brackets onto a `stack: mut List<String>` and verify `matchingClose(list.popBack(mut stack)) == ch` on every closing bracket.

exercises.title: Reverse Polish Notation Stack Calc
hints: Notice pop order matters for `-` and `/`: the first popped item is `right`, the second is `left`!
Validate stack depth `>= 2` before popping, `right =!= 0` before dividing, and final depth `== 1`.

exercises.title: Matrix Saddle Point Search
hints: Store the matrix flat in `grid: mut List<Int>` at index `r * cols + c`.
Precompute `rowMin[r]` and `colMax[c]`, then scan row-major for the first cell with `val == rowMin[r] and val == colMax[c]`.

exercises.title: Word Frequency Tally & Ranking
hints: Scan tokens made of `text.isNameContinue(ch)` and normalize each token with `text.toLowerAscii`.
Track counts in parallel `words` / `counts` lists and insertion-sort by descending `count` then alphabetical tiebreak.

exercises.title: Merge Overlapping Closed Intervals
hints: Sort `(starts[i], ends[i])` ascending by `start` then `end` before scanning.
Merge whenever `starts[m] <= curE`, extending `curE = max(curE, ends[m])`.

exercises.title: Canonical Roman Numerals
hints: Store the 13 descending fixed arrays `values := [1000, 900, ...]` and `syms := ["M", "CM", ...]`.
Reject `n < 1 or n > 3999` with `"INVALID"`.

exercises.title: INI Config Parser & Queries
hints: Use `list.listIndexOfText(keys, fullKey)` to overwrite an existing key cleanly instead of appending duplicates.
Trim around `section` in `[section]` as well as around `=` in `key = value`.

exercises.title: Precedence & Power Expression Evaluator
hints: Layer precedence cleanly: `parseExpr` (`+ -`) -> `parseTerm` (`* / % :/ :%`) -> `parseUnary` (`-`) -> `parsePow` (`**` calling `parseUnary` recursively).
Check `rest < text.length(trimmed)` after parsing to catch trailing tokens like `1 + 2 )`.

exercises.title: Minimum-Cost Grid Path (Dijkstra)
hints: Initialize cell `0`'s distance to `cost[0]` and all other cells to a large sentinel `INF`, updating distances via a `mut List<Int>` helper.
Note paths can step up/left around high walls (all 4 cardinal directions), not only down/right.

exercises.title: LRU Cache Eviction Simulator
hints: Maintain parallel `keys` and `vals` lists with index `0` as most-recently-used.
Both `GET` (hit) and `SET` (update) must shift the accessed entry to index `0`; inserting when full pops from the back.

exercises.title: Wildcard Glob Matcher (* & ?)
hints: Store the last `*` position (`starP`) and string position (`matchS`) so mismatches backtrack greedily without exponential blowup.
After the candidate string ends, skip any trailing `*` characters in the pattern.

exercises.title: Stack Bytecode Virtual Machine
hints: Pre-parse lines into parallel `ops: mut List<String>` and `args: mut List<Int>` so `JNZ <pc>` can jump to any instruction index `0..instrCount-1`.
Track `steps` and return `ERR:LOOP` when exceeding 1000 steps.

exercises.title: Order Invoice Summary
hints: Construct `LineItem { = qty, = unitPrice }` when `discountPct <= 0` so `discountPct` keeps its default `0`, and compute `gross - ((gross * disc) / 100)` inside a helper.
Track bounds in a fixed `[Int; 2]` array unpacked with `[nextLo, nextHi] := ...` and return `(total = sum, minLine = lo, maxLine = hi)`.

exercises.title: Ticket Pricing Router
hints: Match `Ticket` records in priority order: `{ < 12 = age }`, `{ vip == true, 1 or 2 = zone }`, `{ vip == true }`, `{ >= 65 = age }`, `{ = zone } if 1 <= zone <= 3`, and `_`.
Count VIP tickets (`vipFlag == 1`) separately from the price calculation and print `total vipCount`.

exercises.title: Word Frequency Counter
hints: Use `map.getOr(counts, word, 0)` to read the current count for `word` without faulting on first sight.
Update the tally with `counts[word] = map.getOr(counts, word, 0) + 1;`.

exercises.title: Traffic Signal Cycle
hints: Write an exhaustive helper `nextSignal(s: Signal): Signal` mapping `.Red -> .Green -> .Yellow -> .Red`.
In a loop of `steps` iterations, add `cur.value` to `elapsed` and set `cur = nextSignal(cur)`.

exercises.title: Unique Visitor Counter
hints: Insert each visitor name with `set.add(mut visitors, name);`.
Duplicates are ignored automatically in O(1), so `set.size(visitors)` gives the unique count.

exercises.title: Loop .collected Filtering
hints: Use `loop raw { if .item > 0 { .item * 2 } }.collected` so non-positive items are skipped without appending.
Read `doubled.length()` and `doubled.isEmpty()` directly on the collected `List<Int>`.

exercises.title: Collection & String Metadata Properties
hints: `String` and `List<T>` expose `.length()` and `.isEmpty()`.
`Set<T>` and `Map<K, V>` expose `.size()` and `.isEmpty()`.

exercises.title: Copy-on-Write Record Field Updates
hints: Update nested fields directly on `var player`: `player.pos.x += dx;` and `player.pos.y += dy;`.
Update `player.hp -= dmg;`; copy-on-write keeps `snapshot` untouched.
